## In this demo, we present RNAEventProfiler. For this demonstration, we are utilizing a subset of 50,000 editing sites derived from a subset of TRIBE data obtained from Flammand et al., Genes Dev., 2022. The dataset was generated by processing the raw data with STAR for read alignment, followed by the Bullseye pipeline for A-to-I editing calling as in Flammand et al., Genes Dev., 2022.

## Load the libraries and the annotation data
```{r}
# Libraries
library(tidyverse)
library(data.table)
library(ggplot2)
library(GenomicRanges)
library(SummarizedExperiment)
library(RNAEventProfiler)

# Load Annotation Data 
load("../inst/extdata/ens_anno_115_hs.RData") # function for the generation of the annotation data will be included in the full release of the RNAEventProfiler

```

## First we create the SE object with the function create_SE_object, we give in input an event matrix, a coverage matrix, rowData and colData of a subset of 50k sites from the TRIBE experiment (Flammand et al., Genes Dev., 2022).
```{r}
col_data <- read.csv("../inst/extdata/col_data.csv", row.names = 1, check.names = FALSE)
event_matrix <- read.csv("../inst/extdata/event_matrix.csv", row.names = 1, check.names = FALSE)
cov_matrix <- read.csv("../inst/extdata/cov_matrix.csv", row.names = 1, check.names = FALSE)
row_data <- read.csv("../inst/extdata/row_data.csv", check.names = FALSE)

se <- generate_SE_object(
  event_counts = event_matrix,
  total_counts = cov_matrix,
  colData = col_data,
  rowInfo = row_data,
  fix_coords = "end" # changes from 0 based to 1 based coordinates
)
```

## The aggregate_sites function takes a SummarizedExperiment (SE) object as input and groups event sites into clusters based on a defined distance threshold (in nt) or functional units.

```{r}
se_agg <- aggregate_sites(
  se, 
  by = "distance", 
  max_gap = 25, 
  keep_cols = c("external_gene_name", "biotype")
)
```

## Now we apply the run_differential_analysis function which performs differential analysis. Results are saved in the RowData of the SE object

```{r}
# 1. Define all the contrasts you want to analyse. In this case we are comparing A-to-I editing in YTHDF constructs with non-specific editing of the ADAR-only construct
my_contrasts <- c(
  "DF1_adar_vs_adar_only"  = "DF1_adar - adar_only",
  "DF2_adar_vs_adar_only"  = "DF2_adar - adar_only",  
  "DF3_adar_vs_adar_only"  = "DF3_adar - adar_only"
)

# 2. Run the differential analysis
se_results <- run_differential_analysis(
  se = se_agg, 
  condition = "condition",
  contrasts = my_contrasts,
  norm_method = "TMM",
  stat_type = "PValue",
  p_threshold = 0.05,
  lfc_threshold = 0,
  method = "LRT",
  delta_threshold = 0.01
)

# 3. All the results are in the rowData
head(rowData(se_results))
```

## With this last chunk we are performing genome-to-transcript mapping and creating a metaprofile
(Function still in development)
```{r}
# Map genomic coordinates to transcriptome
se_results_mp_to_tr <- se_results
se_results_mp_to_tr <- map_to_transcriptome(se_results_mp_to_tr, ense, enst, ensg)

# Extract rowData and calculate the central position of each peak to plot
plot_df <- as.data.frame(rowData(se_results_mp_to_tr))
plot_df$pos <- ceiling((plot_df$tx_start + plot_df$tx_end) / 2)


# Pivot classification columns to long format and filter for YTHDF-specific sites
plot_df_long <- plot_df %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = c(DF1_adar_vs_adar_only_Class, DF2_adar_vs_adar_only_Class, DF3_adar_vs_adar_only_Class),
    names_to = "group",
    values_to = "Class"
  ) %>%
  filter(Class == "+")
plot_df_long$group <- factor(plot_df_long$group, levels = c("DF1_adar_vs_adar_only_Class", "DF2_adar_vs_adar_only_Class", "DF3_adar_vs_adar_only_Class"), labels = c("YTHDF1", "YTHDF2", "YTHDF3"))

# Define color palette for the groups
meta_palette <- c(
  "YTHDF1" = "#F4A261",
  "YTHDF2" = "#2A9D8F",
  "YTHDF3" = "#9D4EDD"
)

# preparing annotation object for transcript metaprofile of protein coding genes
r_anno <- enst %>% filter(canonical == "T" & !l_5utr == 0 & !l_cds == 0 & !l_3utr == 0 & transcript_biotype == "protein_coding") %>%
  mutate(tx_5utr_start = 1,
         tx_5utr_end = l_5utr,
         tx_cds_start = l_5utr+1,
         tx_cds_end = l_5utr+l_cds, 
         tx_3utr_start = transcript_length- l_3utr+1,
         tx_3utr_end = transcript_length)

# 4. Metaprofile Calculation
message("Calculating metaprofiles...")
p_calc <- plot_metaprofile(
  plot_df_long,
  r_anno,
  split_by = "group",
  pos_df_cols = c(pos = "pos", transcript_id = "ensembl_transcript_id", count = "peak_id"),
  percentages = TRUE,
  total_bins = 100,
  group_colors = meta_palette, 
  smooth = T)

p_calc
```
